MOS Gilbert double-balanced mixer
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VB vb 0 0.9
VRP rfp 0 SIN(1.3 10m 100k)
VRN rfn 0 SIN(1.3 10m 100k 0 0 180)
VLP lop 0 SIN(2.0 .7 1Meg)
VLN lon 0 SIN(2.0 .7 1Meg 0 0 180)
XDUT vdd 0 op om rfp rfn lop lon vb astra_055_mos_gilbert_balanced_mixer
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec lower_cos range -0.15 -0.01 unit=V
* @spec lower_sin range -0.03 0.03 unit=V
* @spec upper_cos range 0.01 0.15 unit=V
* @spec upper_sin range -0.03 0.03 unit=V
* @spec rf_feedthrough range -0.005 0.005 unit=V
* @spec lo_feedthrough range -0.005 0.005 unit=V
* @spec common range 2.6 3.2 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 2n 40u
let vd = v(op)-v(om)
let lo_c = vd*cos(2*pi*900k*time)
let lo_s = vd*sin(2*pi*900k*time)
let hi_c = vd*cos(2*pi*1.1Meg*time)
let hi_s = vd*sin(2*pi*1.1Meg*time)
let rf_leak = vd*sin(2*pi*100k*time)
let lo_leak = vd*sin(2*pi*1Meg*time)
meas tran lower_cos AVG lo_c FROM=20u TO=40u
meas tran lower_sin AVG lo_s FROM=20u TO=40u
meas tran upper_cos AVG hi_c FROM=20u TO=40u
meas tran upper_sin AVG hi_s FROM=20u TO=40u
meas tran rf_feedthrough AVG rf_leak FROM=20u TO=40u
meas tran lo_feedthrough AVG lo_leak FROM=20u TO=40u
meas tran common AVG v(op) FROM=20u TO=40u
write out.raw v(op) v(om) v(rfp) v(rfn) v(lop) v(lon) v(vb)
quit
.endc
.end
